prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
ai_overview_text:
The best AI video generator for ads depends on your specific workflow: Creatify AI is top-rated for e-commerce and rapid A/B testing, HeyGen excels at realistic AI avatars and multilingual UGC ads, and platforms like Seedance 2.5 (via Higsfield) or Top View are favored for cinematic, prompt-driven product shots. Reddit·r/generativeAI +4
Creatify AI: Built specifically for performance marketers and e-commerce brands. It turns product URLs into complete video ads, supports avatar presenters, and lets you mass-produce variations (different hooks, scripts, and calls-to-action) for multi-variant testing. Creatify AI
HeyGen (AI Video Ad Generator): Best for user-generated content (UGC), lifestyle, and spokesperson-style ads. It offers 175+ languages, realistic digital avatars, and automated script-to-video pacing designed for TikTok, Meta, and YouTube. HeyGen
Seedance 2.5 / Higsfield: Ideal if you want high-end, cinematic visuals and tight camera/scene control. Higsfield allows you to access models like Seedance 2.5 in one place to direct product sequences and motion. Reddit·r/generativeAI
InVideo AI: Great for fast, text-to-video workflows. It handles scriptwriting, stock media assembly, voiceovers, and dynamic captions from a simple text prompt. invideo AI +2
Top View: Uses an AI agent workflow (compatible with tools like ChatGPT) to research viral competitor hooks, plan product shot lists, and assemble multi-clip video ads from a single link or prompt. YouTube·Ai Lockup
What is the product or service you are advertising?
Which platform will you run the ad on (TikTok, Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn)?
Do you prefer talking avatars/UGC or cinematic/product-only visuals?
